title: MeetingIntelligenceOutput
description: Contract for the Meeting Intelligence Agent's structured output, enforced via the OpenAI Responses API's JSON-schema mode (research.md R8). Implements constitution Principle IV (Structured AI Outputs, NON-NEGOTIABLE) and spec FR-007/FR-008/FR-009/FR-024.

summary.description: Overview of the meeting. If the transcript (or a chunk, per FR-024) lacked enough information for a confident overview, this MUST say so explicitly rather than inventing content (FR-009).

confident.description: false means the transcript did not clearly support this statement; it MUST still be surfaced, not omitted, per FR-009.

owner.description: null when no owner is confidently identifiable — the system renders this as the 'Unassigned' placeholder (FR-011); the AI MUST NOT guess an owner.

deadline.description: null when no deadline is confidently identifiable — rendered as 'No deadline' placeholder (FR-011).
